'''2009 Bespin Regionals Brian Herold LS Naboo: Theed Palace Generator Core''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Brian Herold]] at [[2009 Bespin Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Naboo: Theed Palace Generator Core|Ref3-L-nabootheedpalacegeneratorcore.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Aaron Nelson Told Me To Play This
* '''Username:''' Walter Crunkite
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS17]]
